text:
maria: paging: eu-west-2 latency + 95th token lat spike, error ratio (5xx) approx 6% last 5m. Customers reporting slow completions. alert: /alerts/rls-eu-5xx spike

oncall-bot: @maria @tom SRE page triggered (sev2). runbook: region-failover-guidance. escalation in 8m.

tom: seeing provider A upstream timeouts in the provider dashboards, connection resets up ~8x. tail logs show many `connection reset by peer` on worker-gpu-*.

kevin: fwiw we also have high prefix cache miss for a few hot endpoints — might be causing burst of cold calls. checking cache telemetry now.

jess: CS confirms 3 customers on EU region complaining of 502/504s, one is degraded in-prod (non-critical).

maria: ok i'll start a staged failover to eu-west-1 for non-SLA traffic and apply quota cap on eu-west-2. patching traffic steering now. keeping canary 10% to monitor.

maria: plan: 1) apply soft quota on eu-west-2: reduce per-key rps by 30% for non-sla tier 2) route 30% of new sessions to eu-west-1 (provider B) 3) enable incremental provider reroute for model-variants that support quantized fallback 4) monitor 5m; escalate to full region failover if 5xx > 2% for 10m

kevin: +1. deploy-bot: recorded action: staged-steering-start by maria at 1992045689.

maria: applying quota patch now:```
PATCH /config/quotas/eu-west-2
{
  "per_key_rps_multiplier": 0.7,
  "tiers": ["free","standard"]
}
```

maria: command: `curl -X PATCH https://ops.internal/config/quotas/eu-west-2 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d @quota.json`

kevin: I see the quota changes taking effect on the rate limiter (rls-1). per-key RPS 70% of baseline. 502s down slightly. good.

tom: kicking traffic steer: route 30% new to eu-west-1 via steering-mgr. config snippet:```
steering:
  region_preference: [eu-west-2, eu-west-1]
  weights:
    eu-west-2: 0.7
    eu-west-1: 0.3
  session_affinity: sticky
```

maria: executed. `steerctl apply --env prod --policy eu-staged-1992045678.yaml` returned 200. deploy-bot: steering-update recorded.

kevin: early telemetry looks good: p50/p95 cpu on eu-west-2 down 22%, queue length reduced. some providers still showing slow tail lat.

jess: letting affected customers know: "we're actively routing traffic to nearby region and applying temporary quota to reduce failures. We'll update in 10 minutes."

oncall-bot: handoff reminder @tom you're on-shift for next 30m. please ack.

tom: ack. monitoring console: https://console.internal/redwood/metrics?range=5m&filter=eu-west-2

maria: small regression — model-variant X50 shows increased token decoding stalls when routed to eu-west-1 (different provider B). I'll pin X50 to eu-west-2 for SLA customers only and move non-sla to X30 quantized variant.

maria: config:```
variants:
  X50:
    allowed_regions: [eu-west-2]
  X30-quant:
    allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-west-2]
    fallback: true
```

kevin: implemented variant pinning. monitoring quality evals — minimal diffs so far.

tom: error ratio currently 1.6% (5m). latency p95 back to 180ms from 420ms. looks like staged steering + quota is working.

maria: good. next step: hold for 10m, if stable we'll expand steering to 50/50 for non-SLA, and remove quota for free tier (they're most affected).

15m_check: kevin: still stable; small blips but under threshold.

maria: increasing steer weight to 0.5/0.5 for non-sla: `steerctl update --weights eu-west-2=0.5,eu-west-1=0.5 --policy eu-staged-1992045678.yaml`

deploy-bot: steering-change applied by maria at 1992045805.

jess: customer update: "we've shifted additional traffic and reduced error rates; services should recover shortly. We'll follow up with a post-incident note."

oncall-bot: note: handoff scheduled to tom at 1992045900.

tom: seeing slight increase in provider B tail lat for X30-quant but still within SLAs. keep an eye on quality regressions — kevin run evals on sample prompt set.

kevin: running evals now -> no major semantic regressions, token-level diff <1.2% on the sample set.

maria: 40m since start: errors at 0.9%, latency stable. i'm going to lift the soft quota for standard tier and keep quota for free at 0.85 to protect capacity.

maria: lifting standard quota:```
PATCH /config/quotas/eu-west-2
{
  "per_key_rps_multiplier": 0.85,
  "tiers": ["free"]
}
```

kevin: noted. queue length normalizing. I'll keep cache warming for hot prefixes for next hour.

jess: preparing postmortem template, will include timeline and communications. tagging impacted customers for follow-up.

maria: any objections to closing the incident as "mitigated" and moving to monitoring with follow-up action items?

tom: +1 from me. we'll keep an alert rule to watch 5xx for next 3h.

oncall-bot: incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. incident-ref: INC-1992045678.

maria: final notes: root cause probable provider A upstream instability combined with a temporary cache miss storm. mitigation combo: quota, steering, variant pinning, and cache warming. follow-ups: 1) provider SLA check 2) improve prefix KV cache warmers 3) harden steering rollback playbook.

jess: saved customer comms draft to /docs/incidents/INC-1992045678-draft.md

maria: thanks team. I'll draft the postmortem and assign action items. :white_check_mark: 

oncall-bot: thread closed for active paging. you can reopen if regressions observed.
